SS 3.2.1 `Client Authentication` was also read and says “Confidential clients MUST authenticate with the authorization server as described in Section 2.4 when making requests to the token endpoint” -- that is TOKEN-ENDPOINT client authentication, a different location from this subcase's resource-server presentation, and is recorded rather than stretched
